mechanics.title: Breaking
mechanics.description: By default breaking a Lootr container shows a warning and requires sneaking; configurable (never, always, or break-to-drop-loot).

mechanics.title: Decay and refresh
mechanics.description: Optional per-loot-table timers can destroy a container after opening (decay) or regenerate its loot after a delay (refresh); particles indicate this.

mechanics.title: Existing worlds
mechanics.description: Containers already opened before installing are not converted. Removing Lootr deletes all Lootr containers.

mechanics.title: Advancements
mechanics.description: 21 advancements, e.g. opening 1/10/25/50/100 containers, each container type, and each copper chest variant.

commands_and_keybinds: /lootr custom: standing on a vanilla chest, turns it into a shared 'starter' chest with a per-player copy of its contents (operator only)
/lootr has more subcommands; see the Lootr wiki
getting_started: Explore structures as usual and open loot chests; each player gets their own copy of the loot.
editor_notes: Required on both client and server. Pack has no config override. Data includes 72 lootr tags (blacklist/whitelist style). Centennial Trophy origin unverified.
name: Lootr
summary: Loot containers generated from loot tables (chests, trapped chests, barrels, shulker boxes, minecarts, decorated pots, suspicious blocks, item frames) give each player their own inventory, so nobody misses loot or finds an already-looted chest. Containers look different, and change colour from gold to blue once you have opened them.
